_comment: Pricing inputs used by `npm run catalog:import` (when a row has no selling price) and `npm run catalog:report`. CONFIRM every value. Exchange rates: SAR per 1 unit of currency. USD is pegged at 3.75 SAR; fill TRY/EUR with the rate you actually pay.
_marginNote: defaultMarginPercent is the target gross margin as a share of the selling price (45 = 45% of the price is margin).
